title: Second corrective addendum: readiness bootstrap, findings set, scenario gates, override allowlist, timeout and audio-owner gates
frozen_before: any reevaluation or measurement under the second-corrected tools

supersedes.note: Additive. The original predeclared.json, protocol.sha256 and every pre-existing docs/research/live-jam-replay artifact remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

reason: Second independent review BLOCKed a3ecf1f. These corrections tighten gate meaning; they are not new measurements.

N1_readiness_bootstrap.defect: The harness read readJamLiveState before any prepare, when the latest-value slot is unpublished, so backendKind=unknown/usable=false persisted and a good product was reported awaiting-backend.
N1_readiness_bootstrap.correction: prepareToPlay first (proper cold publish), then a bounded off-callback read loop (max 2000 attempts, 1 ms sleep) to obtain a coherent prepared tag; always releaseResources() before the cells. Bootstrap runs outside the armed region and is excluded from counters. The default actual backend must be exactly experimentalBTrack; no arbitrary injected actual identity. Self-check failures (instrument/support/facade) fail closed before any measurement.

N2_findings_set.defect: The harness emitted a finding when (alloc||free||lock), but the validator expected only alloc, so free-only or lock-only runs produced a spurious findings/status mismatch.
N2_findings_set.correction: One finding per phase (cold/warm) when ANY measured allocator family, free family or lock/trylock/unlock/cond occurred. Authoritative C++/C + delete/cfree scope; overflow cannot be clean. Correctly reported findings are a real RT gate failure (status measured-findings), not an invalid-identity error.

N3_scenario_gates.defect: The validator ignored the scenarios block entirely.
N3_scenario_gates.correction: Full scope requires both preregistered scenarios. default_clean_long must have run with the actual experimentalBTrack backend and real audio-owner advancement. injected_join_stop_resync must have run with the injectedTest backend and actual processor/clock/renderer evidence (join observed, steps fired, StopNow stopped, resync accepted, generation changed on re-prepare, shutdown released). If the injection seam is absent, full scope is callback-coverage-only: join_proof_unavailable is a gate FAIL with a known reason code, never a hard pass. Smoke may omit scenarios and is clearly partial; it never claims first-audible verified.

N4_override_allowlist.defect: Preflight accepted any non-immutable override path and any hash.
N4_override_allowlist.correction: Canonical allowlist of exactly three changed pipeline compile seams, pinned to exact hashes: src/jam/DrumClockBridge.h=c115eb8b24f0918f7a375f6507d094cf94d5a0fc99019bba6cf5b3b4459d1025, src/PluginProcessor.h=3e1958e3eccc3892304f8a42c28a1c7cdf711c226e7ec91082211b0d80059930, src/PluginProcessor.cpp=21e3d7ad2cb8a0d5f8fb4f068ee82ac3332a0bf8a4cdaaede062bca146e76e66. Unknown paths fail override_unknown_path; immutable headers fail override_immutable and must always match their original pins; duplicate entries fail override_duplicate; a non-preregistered hash fails override_hash_not_preregistered; a file hash not matching the override fails override_mismatch. Paths are canonical (no traversal). The allowlist covers changed pipeline compile seams (header and cpp), not headers only.
N4_override_allowlist.orchestrator_file: docs/research/live-jam-replay-source-pins.json (schema source-pin-overrides/1.0) already links successfully; live-jam-bridge-pin-amendment.json is a chronology document (schema 1) and is not an override input.

N5_link_metadata_required.defect: A no-Ninja fallback used an incomplete static link list that drops BTrack dependencies.
N5_link_metadata_required.correction: Require complete real link metadata; if the metadata tool is unavailable, fail closed with the named missing_link_metadata_tool and never guess an incomplete static list. GNU/Linux tool scope only; no MSVC link claim.

N6_reported_cursor_start.correction: Record the first snapshot cursor before the haveReported flag is set, via a tested helper. A genuinely cold zero snapshot is valid; a forged zero is not.

N7_timeout_partial.defect: A timeout before cells.json wrote measured_partial=false while the validator required true.
N7_timeout_partial.correction: A truthful timeout may have measured_partial=false with counters unmeasured (not zero); measured_partial=true requires a preserved parsed cells file with its exact hash. Logs are preserved with an exact hash; the timeout deadline is <=300 s. A timeout artifact is a failure of the whole goal and never a gate pass.

N8_audio_owner_gate.defect: audio_owner_measured/0 could be vacuously valid when the cursor never advanced.
N8_audio_owner_gate.correction: Every measured cell must have audio_owner_measured=true and real advancement: audio_owner_start == block (cold baseline), audio_owner_end == (warm_blocks+1)*block, audio_owner_end > audio_owner_start, delta_ok true, no mismatches/backwards. Missing/false/forged-zero fails. Source-owner checks stay outside the armed region on the callback thread. identity.source.immutable_pins_ok must be true.

gates.join_gate: full scope requires the injected join/stop/resync scenario to pass

immutable_preserved.note: Updated tool pins are recorded separately after the fix; originals are never rewritten.
